subregion.name: The Eastern Grounds
subregion.summary: A wide eastern wing of spacious halls and adjoining chambers looking out over the valley.

subregion.name: The Great Hearth
subregion.summary: The central gathering hall and reception rooms near the heart of the homestead.

subregion.name: The North Approach
subregion.summary: A narrow sequence of descending passages and transit chambers linking the northern halls to the manor.

subregion.name: The Northern Galleries
subregion.summary: Sprawling stone corridors and halls forming the upper northern tier of the homestead.

subregion.name: The Northwest Cellars
subregion.summary: A secluded, outlying network of stone storage vaults and chambers at the far northwestern boundary.

subregion.name: The South Commons
subregion.summary: A bustling interior cluster of shared rooms and halls just south of the main concourse.

subregion.name: South Gate
subregion.summary: The fortified entrance complex marking the old city's southern boundary.

subregion.name: The Southwest Range
subregion.summary: An extensive lower wing of workshops, halls, and utilitarian chambers in the southwest.

subregion.name: The West Cloisters
subregion.summary: A dense cluster of domestic chambers, side passages, and small quarters along the west hall.

subregion.name: The West Terraces
subregion.summary: Stepped halls and fortified corridors overlooking the western perimeter.
